anomalies.observed: The net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW contains only the anodes of D4, D14 and D23. No driver, switch, supply or other pin is connected to it, so these three LEDs have no source for their anodes. The sibling net /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV, by contrast, has a driver (U34.4), an enable (U7.5) and a gate (Q10.1).
anomalies.expected: The switched 3.3V indicator rail should be sourced from a supply or power switch, so that the Ethernet link/activity LEDs (D14, D23) and the PI activity LED (D4) can light, as the Ethernet and PI LED circuits require.

anomalies.impact: D4, D14 and D23 cannot be powered, so the Ethernet green/yellow link LEDs and the PI activity indicator stay dark. The rest of the board is unaffected.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows the three LED anodes on /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW with no source on that net, which looks like an open connection that leaves the Ethernet and PI indicator LEDs unpowered. The rest of the connectivity, values and ratings I checked are consistent with the specification and sound practice, so the verdict is tentative.
